title: Every document, every answer,
body: An AI agent that reads sensitive documents and answers with every claim quoted — running entirely on the hardware in front of you.

steps.label: 1 — RETRIEVE
steps.text: The agent requests a case file through a policy gate. Every read is audited.

steps.label: 2 — REASON
steps.text: A 120-billion-parameter model, split across two machines in this booth, reads the file.

steps.label: 3 — CITE
steps.text: Every claim comes back in quotes. If the document doesn't say, the agent says so.

title: It cannot reach
accent: what you did not grant it.
body: Revoke its access to the records system and the same question returns a refusal — in the agent's own words. It keeps its model. It simply has no permission to read that file.
